name: LAMMPS
summary: A classical molecular dynamics code; this Hub bundle models four self-contained Lennard-Jones examples covering bulk, minimization, and driven channel flow.

presentation.about: LAMMPS simulates collections of atoms and molecules using classical molecular dynamics. Its command-based input language supports a broad range of materials and soft-matter problems.
presentation.rationale: Four self-contained Lennard-Jones examples cover bulk dynamics, minimization, and two driven channel flows. They show how a shared DIPL contract can map both common controls and distinct physical driving mechanisms into native commands.

visual.alt: LAMMPS logo formed from colored atom-like spheres

scope: DIPL input generation for the pinned examples/melt/in.melt, examples/min/in.min, examples/flow/in.flow.couette, and examples/flow/in.flow.pois scripts.
validation_qualifier: Twelve adapter tests passed on 2026-10-11. Active commands match all four pinned upstream examples. Local serial smoke runs covered the two original examples; the flow examples are parity-tested but have not had smoke runs. Scientific-result validation is not claimed.

evidence.label: Pinned LAMMPS LJ and flow examples

limitations: This independent external adapter covers four self-contained Lennard-Jones examples, not the LAMMPS input language or package catalogue. The local build and two original-example smoke runs do not establish scientific validation for the flow cases, other-platform support, or upstream endorsement.
